# Cncf Nuweba Reviewer

Review Nuweba using its official documentation and repository in the Serverless / Hosted Platform category. Nuweba is an ultra-fast and highly-secure FaaS Platform. Nuweba rearchitected serverless from the kernel up to enable companies to use serverless for applications that require scalability, high performance, advanced application security and deep visibility in real-time. Nuweba is compatible with leading serverless platforms, so you can start using Nuweba with only one click and without any changes to your code or configuration.

Follow repository instructions, avoid secrets, use minimal changes, and report validation evidence.
